title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode2 We Can't Lose Either

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to meet with me today. I know you're both very busy people.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You don't need to be so formal with us.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yeah, have a seat. I'll ask someone to bring us some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, that won't be necessary.
I plan on leaving before Emu returns.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What is this “important matter” you wished to discuss with us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to discuss what we'll be doing as a troupe moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Would you mind elaborating...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To cut to the chase...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I would like Wonderlands×Showtime to become a freelance troupe that operates independent of the park.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Freelance...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Care to explain further...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, as I'm sure you're both keenly aware, Tsukasa and Nene are absolutely aching to keep growing as actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And in order to do that, they feel that they'll need to go out into the world and experience many new things.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to support them in their endeavors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe they should be allowed to spread their wings, work with other actors, troupes, groups and companies...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simultaneously...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like the four of us to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My hope is that we can pursue our dreams together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like the opportunity to separate ourselves from the park and become a freelance troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also understand that us leaving so suddenly would cause quite a few problems for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been fortunate enough to gain a sizable fan base through the night shows and our ambassadorial performances.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you have...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The numbers for anything show-related have only been going up. And your troupe's role in that has not been small.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If possible, we'd like for you all to stay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't wish to cause you or the park any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm proposing a solution that benefits both us and Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a freelance troupe, we could agree to a deal that allows us to keep performing shows on a semi-regular basis at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That would certainly help us quite a lot, since we wouldn't have to immediately part ways with Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As the park's operators, we can't immediately get on board with your proposal.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: First, once you leave the park, you'll be putting on fewer shows there. That puts us in a tough position.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
And there are other issues to consider.
We'd be giving you special treatment, which the other cast members may not like.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Worst case scenario, others will see what you're doing as a sign to also go independent. Operating the park would become incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: With those considerations in mind, we can't give just your troupe special treatment...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: There's also a point we need to set straight.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You said you'd like “the four of you” to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: So, you're including Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm here not only to ask you both about us becoming freelancers, but also to discuss this matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind allowing me to invite Emu along?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (I had a feeling this would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Do you understand what you're saying...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You're essentially trying to take away a member of the Otori family.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I know I'm asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I feel that I need to ask Emu to come with us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just once. Please, give me a chance to invite her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's our dear friend...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This is ultimately her decision to make.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, you becoming freelancers poses many problems for us.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we're also not in a position to force you to stay on your current contracts.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
We'll consider your proposal...
Let us hope that it works out for both parties in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Practice should be ending soon.
Emu's going to be home in not too long...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'll take my leave here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again, thank you both for taking the time out of your busy schedules to meet with me.
